fields.title: Output mode
fields.description: Choose whether to append a new column with the outcome of the rules, or replace an existing column.

fields.title: Append column
fields.description: Name of the newly appended column, which contains the outcome of the rules.

fields.title: Replace column
fields.description: The column to replace with the rule outcome.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Enable PMML RuleSet generation
fields.description: When checked, PMML mode evaluation is used and fails if the input cannot be translated to PMML.

fields.title: Hit selection
fields.description: The method used to select the outcome when multiple rules match.

fields.title: Default value/score
fields.description: The default score/value to use when no rules matched.

fields.title: Default rule confidence
fields.description: The default confidence value to use when it is not specified by the confidence column.

fields.title: Rule confidence column
fields.description: Specifies confidence of the rules based on the values in the selected column.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Default rule weight
fields.description: The default weight value to use when it is not specified by the weight column.

fields.title: Rule weight column
fields.description: Specifies weight values for the rules based on the values in the selected column.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Append confidence values
fields.description: When checked, confidence values are computed and written into a new column in the output table.

fields.title: Confidence column name
fields.description: The name of the column to write confidence values into.

fields.title: Provide statistics
fields.description: When checked, recordCount (and if Validation column is selected, also nbCorrect) is computed for the PMML output.

fields.title: Validation column
fields.description: The column which contains the correct prediction for the input (test/validation) table. When <none> selected, no nbCorrect value will be computed.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Dictionary mode
fields.description: Choose how the rules table encodes the rules.

fields.title: Rule column
fields.description: The column in the rules table that contains the full rule expressions (condition and outcome combined, e.g. "$Col$ > 0 => TRUE").
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Condition column
fields.description: The column in the rules table that contains the condition part of each rule (e.g. "$Col$ > 0").
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Value column
fields.description: The column in the rules table that contains the outcome value for each rule (e.g. "TRUE" or "FALSE").
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Treat values starting with $ as references
fields.description: When checked, values in the value column that start with $ will be treated as references (for example, column, flow variable, or table property references) rather than literal string values.
